Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
At superior MEL, Madrigal says:
[Gain 2 votes], and any vampire voting in agreement with this
vampire gains 1 blood from the blood bank. Any vampire voting
in opposition to this vampire burns 1 blood. Blood is gained
or lost when the results are tallied.

First, are those 2 votes gained by the minion, or by the
Methuselah [like a Political Action card]?

Second, if this minion playing Madrigal does have votes [through
that effect, or a title, or a Bewitching Oration, etc], does
she gain blood for voting "in agreement with herself"? Or
does this effect only apply to other vampires?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> At superior MEL, Madrigal says:
> [Gain 2 votes], and any vampire voting in agreement with this
> vampire gains 1 blood from the blood bank. Any vampire voting
> in opposition to this vampire burns 1 blood. Blood is gained
> or lost when the results are tallied.
>
> First, are those 2 votes gained by the minion, or by the
> Methuselah [like a Political Action card]?

The minion (like an action modifier).

> Second, if this minion playing Madrigal does have votes [through
> that effect, or a title, or a Bewitching Oration, etc], does
> she gain blood for voting "in agreement with herself"? Or
> does this effect only apply to other vampires?

It applies to that vampire as well.
